    Profile

    Envy is a homunculus that was summoned from another world and embodies "envy" - one of the Seven Deadly Sins. Envy is cruel and mean, and often uses the ability to shapeshift to cause strife by manipulating and exploiting human weakness. Envy delights in toying with human lives, but also looks down on their foolishness.
